description: A large round planet has two curved surface marks and a small circular moon overlapping its upper right edge. The planet remains a plain circular body apart from the two open crater-like arcs.
A hanging fabric panel has a broad straight band across its top and long vertical pleats below. The folds end in a gently wavy lower hem, with rounded corners at the outer edges.
A round plum has a shallow notch at the top, a curved stem bending left, and a pointed leaf extending right. A long curved seam follows the right side of the fruit toward its base.
A pointed plumb bob hangs vertically from a straight cord through a small rounded attachment. Its wide, slightly shouldered top narrows symmetrically into a long triangular tip below.
An upright patch pocket has a flat open top, straight sides, and a gently pointed lower edge. A shallow curved row of dashed stitching runs just beneath the upper rim.
A police car appears from the side with two round wheels beneath a long rounded body. A divided cabin sits above, topped by a small roof beacon with three short radiating light marks.
A large rounded pomelo narrows slightly at the top where a short stem rises. A pointed oval leaf sits beside the stem, while the body remains unmarked and broadly curved below.
A low oval pond contains two short wavy water lines. A single upright cattail grows from the far bank, with a rounded seed head and two narrow leaves curving away from its stem.
An upright poster has a rounded rectangular outer edge, a blank square picture area near the top, and two short horizontal text lines beneath it. The lower line is shorter than the upper one.
An upright jar with a broad rounded lid stands behind a low mound of powder. The mound has a rounded triangular silhouette and overlaps the jar's lower right corner, interrupting its outline.
A bull faces left with a long rounded body, a low snout, and two sweeping horns. Four thin legs descend from the belly, with bent hind legs contrasting with the straighter forelegs.
A wide printer has a rounded body and an upright sheet entering from above, with its upper right corner folded. A square print emerges in front, showing two connected mountain peaks.
A rounded prison gate has broad horizontal bands at its top and bottom. Vertical bars divide the middle, framing a central arched doorway whose upper curve meets the middle bar.
A circular planet is crossed by a long elliptical ring running from lower left to upper right. The ring passes in front of the lower part of the globe and reappears behind its upper edge.
Two airplanes are stacked diagonally, with the upper plane facing left and the lower plane facing right. Each has swept wings, a small tail assembly, and a short dashed trail behind it.

Two small airplane profiles face opposite directions on separate levels. The upper aircraft points left and the lower points right, each with a raised wing and tail; a dashed trail follows the lower plane.
A broad upright plus has four equal-looking arms joined around an open center area of the silhouette. Each arm ends in a softly rounded cap, giving the outline a balanced cross shape.
A domed hard hat with a broad brim and central raised ridge sits above a short conveyor. The conveyor has a rounded horizontal body with three evenly spaced circular rollers visible inside.
A front-facing polo shirt has short angled sleeves and a straight lower hem. Two folded collar points meet at the center above a short vertical placket descending onto the plain chest.
A flower faces forward with five broad rounded petals around a small circular center. A slender stem descends beneath the bloom, with one pointed leaf branching left near the bottom.
A large circular mirror sits on a short straight neck above a narrow upright handle. The mirror face is blank, and the handle has straight sides with a rounded lower end.
A long smooth worm curves through alternating bends, dipping down from the upper left before rising toward the right. Its body has rounded ends and an even, soft ribbon-like thickness.
A long feather angles from lower left to upper right, with a narrow shaft extending below its pointed vane. A central quill runs partway upward, and a sharp notch breaks the right edge.
A small plover faces right with a rounded head, pointed beak, and a tiny eye. Its long sloping back leads to a pointed tail, while a curved wing sits above two thin standing legs.
A tadpole faces left with a broad rounded head and a small circular eye. Its body narrows into a long curved tail that sweeps right and bends upward at the tip.
A square wooden panel has rounded corners and a small circular fixing near each corner. Several flowing grain lines cross the face, including an elongated open knot entering from the right edge.
A pony stands in left-facing profile with a short pointed ear, rounded muzzle, and gently sloping neck. Its long back meets a hanging curved tail, while two broad visible legs support the body.
A five-point star floats above a rectangular pedestal with a broad top slab and two supporting sides.

An elongated oval organism tapers into rounded ends, with a narrower upper tip. Three curved transverse bands cross its body, following the outward swell of the middle rather than forming straight stripes.
A winners podium consists of three adjoining rectangular platforms. The central block rises highest, the right block is intermediate, and the left block is lowest, all meeting on a common baseline.

Three slanted ribbon-like bars are stacked vertically between opposing open chevrons. The middle bar leans opposite to the upper and lower bars, while the left and right chevrons frame the arrangement.
A smoking pipe has a deep rounded bowl on the left with a flat upper rim. The bowl flows into a slender curved stem that rises to a short open mouthpiece on the right.
A walking person carries a rectangular case at the left; a small upright airplane mark floats beside the upper right of the figure.
A rounded square outlet plate surrounds a broad horizontal hexagonal recess with softened corners. The recess is blank, with no visible pin holes or switches inside the outlined opening.
A rounded square wall plate contains a large circular socket face. Two small round pin holes sit side by side above a wider semicircular grounding opening, creating a symmetric arrangement.
A front-facing police officer has a blank rounded face beneath a peaked cap with a circular badge. The shoulders form a uniform bust, with an open pointed collar, center seam, and round chest badge.
A circular head sits above a rounded shoulder block, beside a right-facing arrow.
A slender vertical pole rises from the middle of a short horizontal foot. Both the shaft and base are plain straight lines, with no flag, attachments, or ornament visible.
An almond-shaped eye with a round pupil sits inside an upright triangular border.
An upright rounded panel has a single horizontal divider close to its top. The shallow upper band and larger lower area are both blank, with matching rounded corners around the outer edge.
A long horizontal shaft runs into a right-facing open arrowhead. Two straight diagonal arms meet at the tip, forming a broad symmetric point without an enclosing outline around the shaft.
A broad ribbon forms a rounded loop at the top and crosses over itself below. Its two flat-cut tails spread diagonally downward, with the front strand passing from upper right to lower left.

A small bomb descends diagonally toward a house, with its rounded nose pointing lower right and angular tail fins above. The house has a pitched roof and arched doorway, with a short motion stroke behind the bomb.
A diagonal bone with rounded ends sits beside a pointed leaf with a central vein.
A large circular letter Q has a diagonal tail crossing its lower right edge; the source filename names Qualcomm, but the render contains only this character.
A car appears straight from behind with a broad rounded body and a narrower sloping rear window above. Two tires project below, while short inward-curving marks indicate the rear lights.
A small coin purse has a rounded lower body that narrows toward its rigid upper frame. A single rounded clasp protrudes at the top center, and the frame follows the sloping shoulders.

An upright arrow rises from the lower left before curving smoothly into a horizontal shaft toward the right. A broad open arrowhead terminates the upper arm, with two diagonal sides meeting at its point.

A rounded square quilt is divided into four equal patches by a vertical and horizontal seam. Short curved fold marks appear in the upper left and lower right patches, leaving the opposite patches blank.
Two horizontal lines sit to the right of a detached diagonal cross.
An upright rounded panel surrounds a nearly circular clockwise arrow with clock hands.
A round clock sits within a document with a clipped upper right corner and one line below.
A rounded square panel contains three short horizontal lines stacked vertically with even spacing. The lines are aligned at both ends and sit within a wide blank margin around the panel.

A large horizontal hexagon with gently rounded corners surrounds a smaller regular hexagon. A small circle sits at the shared center, producing three nested outlines without connecting lines or other marks.
Two rounded comma-shaped marks sit side by side, with their tails descending and curving left.
Three bars descend in height from left to right below a diagonal down-right arrow.
A diagonal clipped-corner tag with a round hole sits above-left of a separate pointed leaf.
A circular wheel is divided into eight wedge-shaped sections by straight spokes meeting at its center. The outer rim is a single unbroken circle, and no separate central hub is visible.
An open folder with a stepped upper tab holds an upright sheet behind it. The visible page has one short horizontal line and a small square near the upper right corner.
A plain upright rectangular outline has broadly rounded corners and straight sides. Its entire interior is empty, with no color indicator, label, or other mark visible despite the source name.
A round reel has a smaller circular center and a short handle descending beneath it. A thin crank extends to the right, ending in a small raised rounded grip with a downward trailing line.

A rounded hexagonal outer border surrounds an angular folded ribbon form. The inner shape follows the upper left sides, turns into a right-facing point, and folds down into a long lower triangular face.
A hand enters from the lower right and grips an open envelope by its right edge. A letter with one horizontal text line rises above the envelope, whose diagonal folds meet across the front.
A small house sits above a large pointing hand, whose index finger rises at the left of the house.
Two open hands rise on either side of a small house, with fingers upright and palms curving inward beneath it. The house has a pitched roof, an arched doorway, and small gaps at its upper walls.
Two upturned hands flank a small building with an asymmetric sloping roofline. The building has a tall right section, a shorter left section with horizontal floor marks, and a small upright doorway.
A two-handed handshake with squared cuffs sits beneath a detached pitched roof outline.
A radiator has four rounded vertical sections joined into one broad body. The upper and lower edges dip between the sections, and two short pipes descend near the outer ends.
A straight horizontal shaft connects two open arrowheads pointing in opposite directions. The diagonal arms extend equally above and below the shaft, forming a balanced left-right directional mark.
Two long thin horizontal bars are separated by a wide gap. A single diagonal line rises rightward from the middle of the lower bar, ending below the upper bar without touching it.
A small flatbed truck faces left with a rounded cab and two visible wheels. A house sits directly on the bed behind the cab, with a pitched roof and a central arched doorway.

An irregular pointed blast overlaps the upper left corner of a house, enclosing a small diagonal capsule-like projectile. The house's roof and wall outlines are interrupted around the explosion, while its arched doorway remains visible.
Three stars arch above a small house, with the central star larger than the outer two.
A rounded square puzzle piece has an outward circular tab on its right edge and an inward circular socket at the bottom. The top and left edges remain straight between softly rounded corners.
A tapered measuring jug has a pointed pouring spout at the upper left and a squared loop handle on the right. Three short measurement lines descend along the front of the plain body.
A landscape picture shows two mountain peaks and a round sun; a diagonal wand with radiating marks overlaps its upper right corner.
Several overlapping hills form a low landscape beneath a round sun in the upper left. Curved ridgelines rise and fall across the view, with the nearest hill bounded by a straight lower edge.
A long straight shaft extends horizontally toward a compact right-facing open point. The arrowhead has two evenly angled arms, while the left end remains plain and unadorned.
A putty knife stands upright with a broad flat-edged blade at the top. The blade's sides curve inward toward a narrow neck, above a short handle with a rounded bottom.

A circular reel surrounds a smaller circular opening, with a short vertical grip beneath it. A horizontal crank projects rightward and bends up into a rounded end, with a thin line dropping from the bend.
A short railing has broad horizontal top and bottom rails with rounded ends. Three straight vertical supports join the rails, evenly dividing the open space between them into adjoining bays.
An open book has paired text lines on its pages beneath the visible upper half of a gridded globe.
Two broad opening quotation marks sit side by side, each curling upward from a rounded lower block.
Two upright rounded rectangles overlap diagonally. The taller rear panel sits at the upper left, while the smaller front panel covers its lower right corner; both interiors remain blank.

Three simplified people stand behind a stepped winners podium, with the central figure raised highest. Each has a rounded head and curved shoulders, while the podium has a wide base and a tall middle step.
A document has a small square and two horizontal lines, with a large person figure overlapping its right edge.
A portable radio has a low rounded rectangular body with a large circular speaker on the left. A small tuning window and short control line occupy the right, and a slender antenna angles upward.

Two upturned hands rise symmetrically beneath an upright cross, with their fingers open toward its sides. The cross has a long lower stem and short rectangular arms, floating above the inward-curving palms.
A rounded square surrounds four smaller square cells in a two-by-two grid; the lower right cell has gaps.
A quail stands in right-facing profile, with a plump body, pointed beak, and long curved crest above its head. A sweeping wing line separates the upper body from the belly above two thin legs.
A broad quarter-circle shape has straight lower and right sides meeting at a right angle. A single sweeping arc joins their far ends, enclosing a blank wedge with softly rounded corner transitions.
A round radish tapers into a sharp root at the bottom. A short stem rises from the top center and branches into two large pointed leaves spreading upward to either side.

A hooded raincoat appears from the front with rounded shoulders and a central opening line. A closed umbrella stands separately to the right as a long tapered canopy with a short shaft protruding above.
A raspberry is formed from overlapping rounded drupelets that narrow toward the bottom. A single pointed leaf leans left from the top, beside a short curved stem rising to the right.
Two person busts sit below a speech bubble containing a small house.
A four-key calculator overlaps the lower left of a pitched-roof house, whose outline is interrupted behind it.
A house has an arched doorway and an interrupted lower right edge beside a rising zigzag arrow.
A small house sits within a large circular outline with a detached thick quarter segment at upper right.
A simple table has a long rectangular tabletop and two thin straight legs set inward from its ends. The view is frontal, with no chair, contents, or additional support visible.
A plain square mirror has a straight outer border and two diagonal reflection marks inside. The longer stroke sits above and to the left of the shorter one, both slanting upward right.
A reindeer faces forward with a long rounded muzzle, small dot eyes, and an oval nose. Broad ears project sideways below two branching antlers that rise and spread above its head.
An upright remote control has a rounded rectangular body and a large circular button near the top. Six smaller round buttons form two rows beneath it, with a short pill-shaped button at the bottom.
A horizontal right arrow sits in the middle of a rounded square border.
A right-facing arrow sits between two rounded vertical brackets with open top and bottom centers.
Two thick closing quotation marks sit side by side, with rounded upper blocks and long curved lower tails.
A straight horizontal line runs into a large right-facing arrowhead with long diagonal arms. The upper and lower arms meet symmetrically at the tip, leaving the left shaft plain.
A right-pointing triangular outline has rounded corners and an empty interior. Its left edge is nearly vertical, while the upper and lower edges slope toward the softly rounded point at the right.
Three bars increase in height from left to right, with a diagonal up-right arrow above them.
Three bars increase in height from left to right, with a diagonal up-right arrow above them.
Round reading glasses sit above a closed book viewed from its spine edge. The glasses have a curved bridge and short outer temples, while two inset horizontal lines show the book's page block.
A long horizontal rectangle has broad rounded corners and a blank interior. The straight top and bottom edges span most of its width, connected by short upright sides at each end.
Two diagonal lines form a cross inside a rounded square.
A rounded square panel surrounds a small horizontal pill-like rectangular inset. Both outlines are empty, with the inset centered and separated from the outer frame by broad margins.
A plain T-shirt faces forward with a shallow round neckline, two short angled sleeves, and straight sides. Its lower hem is flat, and the chest contains no emblem, pocket, or other mark.
Two upright rails are crossed by three evenly spaced horizontal bars that extend slightly beyond them. A small irregular angled stroke appears at the left middle junction of the otherwise plain grid.
A rounded square puzzle piece has a circular inward socket on its right side. Small gaps interrupt the left and lower outlines, while the upper edge and rounded upper corners remain continuous.
A six-cell solar panel sits above and to the left of a blank desktop monitor. A cable descends from the panel and bends into the monitor, which rests on a short stem and flat foot.
Seven thin upright lines of varying lengths sit inside a rounded square panel.
Two diagonal lines form a cross inside a rounded square.
A rhinoceros stands in right-facing profile with a heavy rounded body and low head. A large horn projects upward from the snout, a pointed ear rises behind it, and broad legs support the belly.
A standing booklet has a sloping rear page visible above its cover, with a star and two text lines on the front.
A closed envelope sits within a segmented circular target whose diagonal corner ticks point inward.
A slender stem branches into three pointed oval leaves, with one upright at the top and two spreading sideways below. Each leaf has a short central vein connected to the branching stem.
A barn has a high angular gambrel roof and straight outer walls. A small square loft window sits above a wide doorway, whose two diagonal braces cross across the lower opening.
Three bent line arrows follow one another around an open triangular center. Each shaft curves around one corner before ending in an open arrowhead, with clear gaps between the separate arrows.

Three small circular nodes are joined by sweeping curved lines in a rotating triangular arrangement. Each curve wraps around the outside before meeting the next node, leaving open gaps along the outer silhouette.

A rounded square outer frame surrounds a smaller rectangular shelving opening. Two horizontal dividers cross the inner opening to create three stacked empty shelves, with a broad margin around the shelving unit.
A broad circular ring is defined by a large outer circle and a smaller centered opening. Both boundaries are unbroken, with no setting, engraving, or other surface detail visible.
Two equal-looking circular outlines overlap side by side to form a narrow lens at their center. Both full circumferences remain visible, and neither circle contains additional marks or text.
Two blank rounded square cards are offset diagonally, with the front card sitting higher and to the left. The rear card remains visible along the right and bottom edges of the overlapping pair.
Three broad bent arrows form an open triangular recycling loop. Their outlined shafts bend around the corners and end in angular points, with small gaps separating the arrows around the empty center.
An upward arrow is centered within a rounded square border.
A large balloon has a rounded upper body narrowing to a pointed lower neck. A short vertical tether joins the balloon to a small square instrument box hanging directly beneath it.

concept: Person in Profile with Swept Hair
description: A person's head faces right, with a clear nose, chin, and short neck. Smooth hair sweeps across the forehead, curves around a visible ear, and ends in a flared shoulder-length section behind.
An elongated rugby ball lies diagonally from lower left to upper right, tapering to rounded pointed ends. A long central seam follows its length, crossed by several short evenly spaced laces.
